title: Anduril Deploys 300th Autonomous Surveillance Tower (AST), Advancing Capability for Border Security
summary: Anduril is proud to announce the deployment of the 300th Autonomous Surveillance Tower (AST) in support of the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), reaching a key milestone supporting Border Patrol Agents' awareness on land and maritime borders. Anduril estimates that ASTs now provide approximately 30% coverage of the U.S. southern land border.
